law.title: Density as exact content-to-support relation
law.statement: Density is the exact positive material-content count or inertial carrier divided by the generated spatial support count of the same observation region.
law.generation_rule: Generate the complete cell support, carrier content, adjacency/transfer, observation scale, provenance, target-access, successor and extra-rule product.
law.grammar_boundary: All finite collective forms generated from exact cells, adjacency, content/support ratios, local transfer, recurrence and observation quotients without importing a continuum field equation or fitted constitutive law.

choices.name: answer-only-scalar
choices.reason: An answer-only scalar erases the generated physical carrier.

choices.name: complete-fold-carrier
choices.reason: The complete Fold trace retains the observed physical distinction.

choices.name: imported-or-fitted-relation
choices.reason: An imported or fitted relation lets consensus or target data select the law.

choices.name: content-over-generated-support
choices.reason: Complete paired counting uniquely normalizes content to support without a free cell scale in the declared observation.

choices.name: unbound-provenance
choices.reason: Unbound provenance cannot demonstrate which premises produced the result.

choices.name: source-bound-proof-trace
choices.reason: Every generated candidate and decision is bound to its exact source trace.

choices.name: target-readable-prediction
choices.reason: A target-readable predictor can copy or optimize against the measurement.

choices.name: capability-closed-prediction
choices.reason: The registered Fold instruction surface has no target or ambient host capability.

choices.name: proof-measurement-conflation
choices.reason: Treating an external decimal record as a proof scalar violates the measured-value boundary.

choices.name: separate-measurement-record
choices.reason: External values remain source-bound records compared only after sealing.

choices.name: selected-favourable-rows
choices.reason: Selecting favorable rows cannot falsify the relation.

choices.name: complete-registered-rows
choices.reason: Every favorable, unfavorable and tampered registered row is retained.

choices.name: finite-answer-lookup
choices.reason: An answer lookup has no successor certificate.

choices.name: one-successor-closure
choices.reason: The One base and generated successor preserve the relation at every declared finite depth.

choices.name: free-extra-rule
choices.reason: A free constant, scale or exception can select the measured answer.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: No rule beyond the admitted dependencies and forced relation is present.

law.exact_result: Fluid density is an exact content-to-support ratio on a complete generated region.
law.induction_base: One generated cell carries one exact content record, boundary adjacency and local transfer state.
law.induction_step: Adding one cell preserves every prior content, adjacency, boundary and transfer trace and appends exactly its source-bound local relations.
exclusions: ungenerated continuum, infinitesimal cell or completed infinity
floating, irrational, imaginary or signed proof magnitude
imported differential equation, fitted coefficient or target-selected phase
target access, omitted cell/transport row or unrecorded boundary transfer
operational_witnesses: Every collective state has complete generated cell support.
Every content change pairs with a named adjacent or boundary transfer.

target_rows.source_locator: IAPWS water and steam property releases

law.falsification_condition: The collective-matter law is falsified if a committed external row lacks the sealed support/transfer/ordering structure, a row is omitted, or the tampered row is accepted.

value_spec.relation_statement: One atomic mass carrier composed with the molar constituent count predicts molar mass content.
value_spec.falsification_condition: The sealed exact mass/count interval does not overlap the released CODATA molar-mass interval or the displaced control is accepted.
